Comment apporter lumière et fluidité dan: How can light and fluidity be brought into a dark, old building?
L’esprit Mid-Century Modern associe chal: Mid-century modern design combines organic warmth with contemporary lines. On the ground floor, living spaces are organised around a central mezzanine; upstairs, the existing stone walls preserve the barn’s character.

Réinventer le rez-de-chaussée de l’École: Reimagining the ground floor of École du Parfum in Grasse to give students a welcoming, flexible and sustainable place. A project bringing together Mediterranean identity and thoughtful everyday use.
Comment retranscrire l’âme du Sud au cœu: How can the soul of the South be expressed within École du Parfum in Grasse?
Le jaune rappelle le soleil et l’identit: Yellow evokes the sun and the school’s identity. Raw materials and dried flowers reflect Grasse’s craftsmanship. A movable partition opens the classroom onto shared spaces. The “Corolle” furniture consists of petal-shaped tables, used independently or assembled into a flower.
A retreat where ideas can emerge.
Le projet « Le Nid » propose un espace r: The “Le Nid” project offers a retreat for students completing their master’s degree. It supports their final project and transition into professional life, using space to encourage concentration and creativity.
Comment l’espace peut-il devenir un décl: How can space help trigger a state of flow?
Bureaux isolés, coworking, galerie d’exp: Private offices, coworking, an exhibition gallery, a shared kitchen, two fabrication labs and a garden form a sensory workspace. Moss greens and earth tones interact with natural materials. The relationship between concrete, wood, light and silence echoes Tadao Ando’s work.
Une mise en scène onirique suit un perso: A dreamlike stage design follows a character undergoing psychoanalysis. Drawing on Freud and Jung, their fears and desires take shape in a world where logic dissolves.
Explorer la frontière entre réalité et i: Exploring the boundary between reality and the unconscious.
Deux univers se répondent : un cabinet r: Two worlds respond to one another: a realistic office built from wooden panels under restrained lighting, and a colourful, shifting psychedelic landscape. Directional lights and flexible acrylic make psychological tensions visible.
Two arches in dialogue with the city.
Une installation pensée pour circuler, s: An installation designed for moving through, sheltering from the sun and taking time to observe the city. Two arches enter into dialogue in Nice’s Coulée Verte.
Faire écho à l’architecture du Vieux Nic: Echoing the architecture of Old Nice.
Les ruelles et les arches du cours Saley: The narrow streets and arches of Cours Saleya inform the design. Corten steel is chosen for its warmth and durability: it captures and filters light, creating shadows that animate the structure.
Un carnet de recherches où l’observation: A sketchbook where architectural observation meets object drawing, portraiture and anatomy. The line is both an analytical tool and a form of expression.
Du feutre fin noir au crayon, du fusain: From fineliner to pencil, charcoal, ballpoint pen and watercolour, these studies explore volume, proportion, texture and light.

Réalisation du plan d’une salle de réuni: Producing a meeting room plan and associated electrical drawings. An approach attentive to regulatory constraints and the needs of the local authority’s departments.
Un stage événementiel en 2025, avec une: An event design internship in 2025, contributing to the design of a shop and the creation of a games room.
